**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/10/19 (Thu) 07:46
- [EVENT] User is planning to run a half-marathon in three months.
- [PREFERENCE] User wants tips on how to increase mileage safely.
- [EVENT] User recently got a new pair of running shoes from the Nike outlet store at the mall.
- [FACT] User can feel the difference in terms of cushioning and support with the new shoes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on the upcoming half-marathon and the new shoes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided 10 tips for increasing mileage safely:
  1. Gradual Progression: Increase weekly mileage by no more than 10% each week.
  2. Listen to Your Body: Pay attention to pain or discomfort.
  3. Build Up Your Base Mileage: Focus on 3-4 shorter runs and one longer run weekly.
  4. Incorporate Walk Breaks: Consider walk breaks if new to running or increasing mileage.
  5. Strengthen Core and Glutes: Incorporate strength training exercises 2-3 times a week.
  6. Incorporate Rest and Recovery: Get 1-2 rest days per week and prioritize stretching.
  7. Hydrate and Fuel Properly: Focus on a balanced diet and hydration.
  8. Get Enough Sleep: Aim for 7-9 hours of sleep each night.
  9. Mix Up Route and Terrain: Vary routes to reduce overuse injuries.
  10. Seek Professional Guidance: Consider consulting a running coach for personalized guidance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised to break in the new shoes gradually by wearing them for shorter runs.
